name: ground-ad
title: Gali Se Ground Tak! DASHX Cricket Tennis Ball
summary: Gali se ground tak, DASHX! Cricket tennis ball ka naya ad.
end_voice: फ्लिपकार्ट और अमेज़न पर। लिंक नीचे है। फॉलो करो!

scenes.image: Wide shot of a sunny Indian cricket ground at golden hour, a 10-year-old Indian boy in a red t-shirt swinging a cricket bat and hitting a red tennis ball high into the sky, friends in green and blue t-shirts cheering in the background
scenes.motion: the boy swings the bat, the red ball flies up into the sky, the camera follows, dust rises, friends cheer
scenes.caption: Ground taiyaar hai, bat pakdo!

scenes.image: Extreme close-up of a fuzzy red felt tennis ball with a single white curved seam, bouncing on the green grass of a cricket ground, dust puffs, sunlight, shallow depth of field, it is a soft tennis ball, not a leather ball, no stitching
scenes.motion: the red ball bounces on the grass in slow motion, dust puffs up, cinematic
scenes.caption: Ye hai DASHX Cricket Tennis Ball!
scenes.voice: ये है डैश एक्स क्रिकेट टेनिस बॉल!

scenes.image: Dramatic low-angle shot of a 10-year-old Indian boy in a green t-shirt hitting a big six with a cricket bat, a red tennis ball flying towards the camera, sunny ground, boys cheering
scenes.motion: the bat swings, the red ball flies towards the camera, the boys jump and cheer
scenes.caption: Zordaar bounce, seedha chhakka!

scenes.image: A group of five cheerful 10-year-old Indian kids in colorful t-shirts celebrating on a cricket ground with arms raised, one holding a red tennis ball, cricket stumps behind them, golden evening light
scenes.motion: the kids jump and cheer, the camera slowly pushes in, golden light shimmers
scenes.caption: Team ka josh, har ball par!
scenes.voice: टीम का जोश, हर बॉल पर!

scenes.image: Two 10-year-old Indian boys in red and green t-shirts sitting on a cricket ground at sunset, each holding a red tennis ball and smiling at the camera, a cricket bat beside them
scenes.motion: the boys smile and wave, the camera slowly pulls back, warm sunset light
scenes.caption: Gali se ground tak, DASHX!
scenes.voice: गली से ग्राउंड तक, डैश एक्स!
